items.author: klara5.myatproto.social
items.context: I made it to the Lethe River before deciding that Banon's death was probably a sign that I should go to bed. Also maybe I should buy some eyedrops, since darkness does anything now? God, I remember this game shockingly well. I guess we all end up with weird childhood artifacts written in our bones?
items.text: Funny how much comes back once you're in it. That game really sticks with you.

items.author: annimh.bsky.social
items.context:
After playing Ocarina of Time, my nostalgia brought me over to Super Mario Galaxy—the game that had my dad STOP playing video games because he’d get sick to his stomach 🤪 Me? Played it so many times!

items.text: Galaxy is such a joy to revisit. Funny that it had that effect on your dad!

Steam 100% completion #39 - GTA Vice City Definitive Edition 🏆 One of my childhood games done and dusted. Still as good as i remember it, despite some downgrades in the definitive edition of the game. Also didn't age as well as i thought it did but still an amazing time nonetheless. 8/10
image, no description
items.text: Congrats on the 100%! Vice City hits differently when it's a childhood game.

items.author: putukspitsvenom.bsky.social
items.context: For a long time I've had vague memories of some weird old PC game I played as a kid, all I recalled it had "cyber"-something in the title. I was never able to find it, but THIS IS IT!!! I'll have to look into it sometime.
items.text: Finding a game you half-remembered for years is a great feeling. If it turns up on GOG, old PC games there usually come ready to run on a modern PC.
